_doc: Exclusions for scripts/check-merge-clobber.mjs. Use this file for deliberate reverts/break-proofs whose commit message cannot carry the [no-clobber-check] marker (e.g. already-landed history). commits: sha prefix (>=7 chars) -> reason, skips that commit in both checks. paths: glob -> reason, always ignores matching paths. reversions: suppress a specific A->B->A blob reversion; path is a glob, by is the reverting commit's sha prefix.
